property_summary: For every call to transfer by the designated msg.sender, the reference contract always returns true; the mutant inverts the non-empty-array check and will allow zero-length arrays causing the function to still return true there but the observable difference is that the reference reverts on zero-length _tos while the mutant does not (so the general rule: calls with empty _tos revert in the reference but succeed in the mutant).
change_summary: Invert the require that _tos.length > 0 to allow zero-length arrays and thus change return behavior for that input.
